editorialSummary.heading: Alvin ISD's 2026-2027 first days, breaks and early release
highlights: August 12 start for four transition groups; August 13 for other students
Fall Break October 12-16 aligns with the Brazoria County Fair
Students return January 6 after winter break and March 15 after spring break
Early release December 18 and May 27, with times listed by school level
paragraphs: Alvin ISD has a staggered start for 2026-2027. Pre-K, Kindergarten, sixth-grade and ninth-grade students attend Transition Day on Wednesday, August 12, while all other students start Thursday, August 13. Fall Break is October 12-16, scheduled to align with the Brazoria County Fair.

Students have no classes November 23-27. November 23-24 are Exchange/Professional Learning days, followed by holiday/break dates November 25-27. After the December 18 early-release day, students remain out through January 5 and return January 6; January 5 is a District Professional Learning day. On early-release days, elementary schools dismiss at 12:10 p.m., junior highs at 12:50 p.m. and high schools at 11:30 a.m.

Spring Break is March 8-12, with students returning March 15. STAAR testing windows are April 6-16 for Language Arts, April 13-23 for Science and Social Studies, and April 20-30 for Math. The last day of school is May 27, 2027, with early release. Alvin ISD also lists Class of 2027 graduation dates from May 24-27 for Shadow Creek, Iowa Colony, Manvel, RISE Academy and Alvin High School.

statistics.label: Student attendance days
statistics.explanation: Calculated from 206 weekdays between the first and last student days, adjusting for 34 confirmed no-school weekdays.

statistics.label: Total no-school weekdays
statistics.explanation: Counted from districtwide no-class events between the first and last student days. Weekends and shortened school days are excluded, and overlapping events count once.

statistics.label: Student no-school days
statistics.explanation: Counts weekdays without regular classes outside holidays and multi-day breaks, including staff or planning days. Overlapping entries count once.

statistics.label: Listed early-release dates
statistics.explanation: Counted from districtwide early-release entries in the official calendar. An early-release date still counts as a student attendance day.

statistics.label: Longest listed break
statistics.explanation: Dec 19, 2026–Jan 5, 2027, including weekends. The stretch contains 12 confirmed no-school weekdays.

statistics.label: Long weekends
statistics.explanation: Counts three- or four-day no-school stretches formed by a weekend plus one or two confirmed weekday closures. Longer school breaks are excluded.

statistics.label: Full-week breaks
statistics.explanation: Counts continuous no-school stretches containing at least five confirmed weekdays without regular classes. Adjacent holidays and weekends remain part of the same break.

comparativeInsights: Transition groups attend August 12 in addition to the general student calendar; the first grading period begins August 13.
The full Thanksgiving student week off combines two professional-learning dates with three holidays, not a uniformly labeled staff holiday week.
Winter holidays and January 5 professional learning create 18 consecutive no-class days including weekends; January 6 starts the next grading period.
On December 18 and May 27, elementary schools dismiss at 12:10 p.m., junior highs at 12:50 p.m. and high schools at 11:30 a.m.
STAAR subject windows overlap and do not mean every student tests daily. Class of 2027 graduations are scheduled May 24-27.

about.dataSource: This page combines Alvin ISD's January 14, 2026 calendar approval announcement, the approved 2026-2027 Academic Calendar PDF and the district's Back to School page. The announcement confirms the approval date, named breaks, last student day and graduation schedule; the PDF supplies the full date grid, grading periods and STAAR windows; the Back to School page supplies campus hours and early-release times.
about.processing: The August 12 first-day event is limited to Pre-K, Kindergarten, grades 6 and 9, while August 13 is the general start. November 23-24 remain separate from the November 25-27 holidays because the staff categories differ, although students are out for the full week. Winter break is shown as a continuous student no-class period through January 5, with January 5 still identified as professional learning. The three STAAR entries preserve the district's complete official windows, including intervening weekends. Teacher-only dates before school and after the last student day are excluded.
about.updates: The Alvin ISD Board of Trustees approved the calendar January 13, 2026, and the district published its approval announcement January 14. The official sources were reviewed October 3, 2026. The approval announcement confirms May 27 as the last student day and lists Class of 2027 graduation dates and venues.
about.disclaimer: The attendance-day totals and break-length calculations are derived from the official dates and are not district-published totals. Early-release days count as student attendance dates. The current calendar does not designate bad-weather make-up dates or report-card distribution dates, and STAAR windows are not individual testing appointments. Ceremony times were not listed in the calendar approval announcement.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school for Alvin ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Pre-K, Kindergarten, sixth-grade and ninth-grade students start Wednesday, August 12, 2026, on Transition Day. All other students start Thursday, August 13.

faqs.question: When is Alvin ISD's last day of school in 2027?
faqs.answer: The last day of school is Thursday, May 27, 2027. It is also an early-release day: elementary schools dismiss at 12:10 p.m., junior highs at 12:50 p.m. and high schools at 11:30 a.m.

faqs.question: When is Alvin ISD fall break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Fall Break is Monday-Friday, October 12-16, 2026. Students return Monday, October 19. Alvin ISD says the break is scheduled to align with the Brazoria County Fair.

faqs.question: Is Alvin ISD off for the Brazoria County Fair in 2026?
faqs.answer: Alvin ISD's Fall Break is October 12-16, 2026. The district says the break is scheduled to align with the Brazoria County Fair.

faqs.question: Does Alvin ISD have school on Labor Day in 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Alvin ISD schedules no classes Monday, September 7, 2026. The district calendar labels the date as Holiday/Breaks.

faqs.question: When is Alvin ISD Thanksgiving break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes November 23-27 and return Monday, November 30. November 23-24 are Exchange/Professional Learning days, followed by holiday/break dates November 25-27.

faqs.question: When is Alvin ISD winter break, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: Winter break follows the December 18 early-release day. Holiday/break dates run through January 4, January 5 is a District Professional Learning day with no student classes, and students return Wednesday, January 6.

faqs.question: When is Alvin ISD spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring Break is Monday-Friday, March 8-12, 2027. Students return Monday, March 15.

faqs.question: Which Alvin ISD professional-learning days have no student classes?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes September 28, November 23-24, January 5 or February 12. September 28, January 5 and February 12 are District Professional Learning days; November 23-24 are Exchange/Professional Learning days.

faqs.question: Does Alvin ISD have school on Presidents Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Students have no classes Monday, February 15, 2027. They are also out Friday, February 12 for District Professional Learning, creating a four-day weekend. Classes resume Tuesday, February 16.

faqs.question: Does Alvin ISD have school on MLK Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Alvin ISD schedules no classes Monday, January 18, 2027. The district calendar labels the date as Holiday/Breaks. Students return Tuesday, January 19.

faqs.question: Is there school in Alvin ISD on March 26 and March 29, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Alvin ISD schedules no classes on Friday, March 26 or Monday, March 29. Together with the weekend, students are out March 26-29 and return Tuesday, March 30.

faqs.question: Does Alvin ISD list bad-weather make-up dates for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The current 2026-2027 calendar does not designate bad-weather make-up dates. If weather or another closure changes the schedule, check Alvin ISD's latest announcement or revised calendar.

faqs.question: When are Alvin ISD early-dismissal days in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Alvin ISD has early release on Friday, December 18, 2026, and Thursday, May 27, 2027. May 27 is also the last day of school.

faqs.question: What time do Alvin ISD schools dismiss on early-release days?
faqs.answer: Alvin ISD lists early release at 12:10 p.m. for elementary schools, 12:50 p.m. for junior high schools and 11:30 a.m. for high schools. The 2026-2027 early-release dates are December 18 and May 27.

faqs.question: What are Alvin ISD's regular school hours for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Elementary schools run from 8:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., junior high schools from 8:40 a.m. to 4:10 p.m., and high schools from 7:20 a.m. to 2:50 p.m. Early-release times are earlier and vary by school level.

faqs.question: When are Alvin ISD grading periods in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The four grading periods are August 13-October 9, October 19-December 18, January 6-March 5, and March 15-May 27. Transition Day for Pre-K, Kindergarten, grades 6 and 9 is August 12.

faqs.question: Does the Alvin ISD calendar list report-card or progress-report dates?
faqs.answer: The academic calendar lists grading-period dates but not report-card or progress-report distribution dates. Check your student's campus communications for reporting dates.

faqs.question: When are Alvin ISD STAAR testing windows in 2027?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists STAAR testing windows of April 6-16 for Language Arts, April 13-23 for Science and Social Studies, and April 20-30 for Math. These windows overlap, are not days off, and do not mean every student tests every day.

faqs.question: What graduation dates are listed for Alvin ISD's Class of 2027?
faqs.answer: Alvin ISD lists Shadow Creek High School on May 24 at Freedom Field, Iowa Colony High School on May 25 at Freedom Field, Manvel High School on May 26 at Freedom Field, RISE Academy on May 27 at Alvin HS PAC, and Alvin High School on May 27 at Freedom Field. Ceremony times are not listed in the calendar approval announcement.

faqs.question: Where can I download Alvin ISD's official 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: Download Alvin ISD's official 2026-2027 Academic Calendar PDF from the link on this page. The district's Campus Hours & District Calendar page is also linked for updates.
